title: Kim Do-yeong crushes grand slam, powers KIA toward playoff series win - CHOSUNBIZ
text:
Kim Do-yeong crushes grand slam, powers KIA toward playoff series win - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 20일(화) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports Kim Do-yeong crushes grand slam, powers KIA toward playoff series win 
 입력 2026.10.20. 19:33 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 KIA Tigers' Kim Do-yeong hit a grand slam that could end the best-of series.
 Kim Do-yeong started at third base and batted third in Game 3 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO best-of-playoffs against the LG Twins at Jamsil Stadium in Seoul on the 20th.
 After flying out to center with one out and a runner on second in the top of the first inning, Kim Do-yeong swung at a 144km fastball on the third pitch from left-handed reliever John Kennedy with the bases loaded and KIA leading 3-0 in the bottom of the second inning, sending a ball over the left-center field wall for a grand slam. It was his fourth postseason home run overall and his third in this best-of playoff.
 Kim Do-yeong, who won the league MVP in 2024, played only 30 games last year due to injury. But he returned this season, appearing in 135 games with a .3008 batting average (496 at-bats, 153 hits), 45 home runs, 118 RBIs, 120 runs scored, 11 stolen bases and an OPS of 1.060.
 Kim Do-yeong's hot streak has continued in the best-of playoff. After hitting multiple home runs in Game 1, he launched a grand slam in Game 3, effectively sealing KIA's victory. KIA is leading 7-0 powered by Kim Do-yeong's homer.
 KIA won both Game 1 and Game 2 and has taken a big lead in this game as well, putting them on the brink of advancing to the playoffs. If KIA succeeds in advancing to the playoffs, the club will achieve its first series win in the best-of playoff after failures in 1994 (Hanwha 2 wins), 2004 (Doosan 2 wins), 2006 (Hanwha 2 wins, 1 loss) and 2011 (SK 3 wins, 1 loss). Kim Do-yeong is the likely series MVP with three home runs. [OSEN]
